name: Comments & timeline
summary: The comment and timeline machinery shared by pull request and issue pages: rendered markdown, the event timeline, the composer with @mentions and uploads, reactions, and hover cards for #references.

flow.label: Activity timeline
flow.note: Sorts comments, commits and events by date, folds rapid label changes, shows both ends first.

flow.label: AppMarkdown
flow.note: Renders sanitized GitHub markdown; #numbers, SHAs, github.com links and @mentions open in-app.

flow.label: Comment composer
flow.note: A textarea with an @mention menu; a pasted or dropped file leaves a placeholder line while it uploads.

flow.label: Media upload endpoint
flow.note: POST /api/comment-media/upload checks the session, the file's magic bytes and its size.

flow.label: R2 comment media
flow.note: Stores the file under comment-media/<user id>/; the comment gets an img or video tag with its URL.

flow.label: createComment
flow.note: Posts the body to GitHub with the viewer's token; the page's queries are then invalidated.

features.name: Activity timeline
features.summary: Comments, commits and events in date order. One person's quick label, review-request and open/close changes fold into one row; long ones show both ends first.

entry.role: Hides the middle, loads more pages

features.name: Markdown rendering
features.summary: GitHub-flavoured markdown with raw HTML passed through a sanitizer, GitHub alerts, footnotes, and Shiki code blocks with a copy button.

entry.role: Renderer wired to routes and GitHub links
Allow-list for HTML in user content

features.name: Mentions and reference cards
features.summary: @logins, #123, commit SHAs and github.com URLs become in-app links with hover cards. Cards paint first from lists and pages already in the cache.

entry.role: Issue, PR and commit links with cards
Finds card data already in the cache

features.name: Comment composer
features.summary: A textarea editor. Comment boxes are a bare field where shortcuts still format, with an @mention menu; descriptions get a toolbar and Write/Preview tabs.

features.name: Image and video upload
features.summary: Paste, drop or attach png, jpeg, gif, webp, mp4, webm or mov. The server trusts the file's magic bytes, not its MIME type; 25 MB images, 120 MB video.

entry.role: Verifies the object, returns the HTML tag

features.name: Emoji reactions
features.summary: The eight GitHub reactions on comments and on PR or issue descriptions. A click updates the count at once and is undone if GitHub refuses.

features.name: Edit, delete, hide, reply
features.summary: Edits and deletes patch every cached copy of a comment and restore it on failure. Replies are quote blocks that the timeline nests under their parent.

entry.role: Applies an edit or delete to cached data

entryPoints.role: Shared detail page shell: column, panel, phone action
One comment with its replies, menu and reactions
Composer at the foot of a PR or issue
Markdown with mentions and references wired in
Comment, reaction, edit and delete server functions
Timeline events: REST plus GraphQL cross-references

goodParts: Upload code is pure helpers plus a handler with an injected runtime, both tested (comment-media.server.test.ts, comment-media-upload.handler.test.ts).
The markdown pipeline has an XSS suite (packages/ui/src/lib/markdown-pipeline-xss.test.ts) next to markdown.test.ts.
watch: No unit test files under components/details: event grouping (grouped-label-event.tsx, 346 lines), reply detection and timeline windowing have none.
The upload endpoint is matched by hand in entry-worker.ts:25, before the router, instead of living under routes/api like the other API routes.
packages/ui/src/components/markdown.tsx is 955 lines and markdown-editor.tsx is 870 lines.

issues.note: Comment uploads to R2 exist since Apr 16. Worth re-testing on issues.
